_meta.dev.emem/mutation: none: this call does not modify server state

dev.emem/observed_latency.note: measured here over recent calls, not a budget

band.description: Optional band key. When set, the minted citation carries the band's tamper-provenance block (class, deterministic, tamper_evidence, trust_rank) so the receiving agent sees the trust class without a resolve round-trip.

fact_cid.description: 52-char base32-nopad-lowercase content-id of the fact (full 32-byte blake3).

observed_on.description: The fact's source capture date (YYYY-MM-DD) as `/v1/recall` reports it in `sources[].captured_at`. Supplied together with `band` it additionally mints the self-describing `descriptor_token`. A wrong date forges nothing: resolve binds the date to the signed fact and answers 409 on a mismatch.

name: emem_memory_token

cell_token.description: The address alone, when you mean the place rather than an observation of it.

grammar.description: The token grammar, so the form can be parsed rather than pattern-matched.

memory_token.description: The citation to paste: emem:fact:<cell64>:<fact_cid>. Copy it verbatim; a hand-assembled token that is one character wrong still reads as a citation and resolves to nothing.

title: Compose a memory_token citation handle
